# Gray4 PNG fixtures

These synthetic 800 × 480 noninterlaced 2-bit images exercise both accepted
encodings. Each contains four equal-width vertical stripes in ascending shades:
black, gray 85, gray 170 and white.

| Fixture | Encoding and use |
| --- | --- |
| [target-gray4.png](target-gray4.png) | Grayscale; shared renderer, delivery, storage, overlay and Job test input |
| [target-indexed-gray4.png](target-indexed-gray4.png) | Indexed with four opaque palette entries; validates the other accepted encoding |

The indexed fixture was generated by the
[HTTP gray-bands renderer](../../examples/renderers/http/gray-bands/renderer.py)
using `png(indexed=True)`. Both files are retained as fixed test inputs. The
grayscale image's SHA-256 is embedded in the
[display response](../protocol/display-response.json) and
[image request](../protocol/display-image-request.http); keep those bytes and
references consistent. The OG PNG size limit is less than 90,000 bytes.

The compatibility contract belongs in [PROTOCOL](../../notes/PROTOCOL.md#png-contract).
These fixtures are not evidence of physical-device acceptance; see
[dated acceptance](../../notes/DEVELOP.md#recorded-acceptance-baseline).
